derelict_hulk.name: Derelict Hulk
derelict_hulk.description: A dead warship drifting in the dark. Fly a fleet in to board it.

outcomes.text: Your crews strip the hulk for parts.
One of its escort craft still flies. A skeleton crew brings it home.
The captain's log names a raider supply route, and the cargo bay is half full.
The reactor was only sleeping. It goes up as you board.

alien_signal.name: Strange Signal
alien_signal.description: A repeating signal from no known source. Fly a fleet in to investigate.

outcomes.text: First contact, of a sort: the signal carries mathematics far beyond yours. Your scientists are ecstatic.
A probe of unknown make maps the region for you before falling silent.
The beings behind the signal trade freely. A strange device changes hands.
The signal is a lure. Something old and automated opens fire before your fleet can break away, but your commander learns from it.

supply_cache.name: Smuggler's Cache
supply_cache.description: Crates tethered to a rock, hidden from scanners. Fly a fleet in to open them.

outcomes.text: Credit chips and trade goods. Finders keepers.
Military-grade ordnance, still sealed.
Medical supplies, enough for a field hospital.

survivor_pods.name: Escape Pods
survivor_pods.description: A cluster of pods, some still beeping. Fly a fleet in to pick them up.

outcomes.text: Survivors of a raider attack. Grateful, and some of them are engineers.
A pilot among the survivors joins your fleet, ship and all.
The pods are empty; whatever was inside got out. Your sensor logs show where it went.

derelict_probe.name: Derelict Probe
derelict_probe.description: One of your own first probes, launched generations ago and long given up for lost. Fly a ship in to recover it.

outcomes.text: Its recorders are intact: decades of readings from the outer system. Your scientists are delighted.
Its last images map the outer system in detail.
The probe's power cell is still good, and its alloy frame is worth recycling.

comet.name: Comet
comet.description: A long-period comet falling sunward, rich in ice and volatiles. Fly a ship in to sample it.

outcomes.text: Your crews tap the comet's ices: fuel and water worth a fortune to the colonies.
Pristine material from the birth of the system. A research bonanza.
An outgassing jet slams into your ships before they can pull away.

old_station.name: Old Station
old_station.description: An early research station, abandoned in a decaying orbit. Fly a ship in to board it.

outcomes.text: The station's stores were never emptied: machine parts and refined metals.
Its automated tender still answers to old command codes. A skeleton crew brings it home.
The station's logs say where the separatists hid their first caches.
